exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts and the phrases in the list to complete the dialogues, as in the example: put some cream on it, put it in cold water, put a plaster on it, go to the gym tonight, get some cough medicine, get you an aspirin, see your dentist, get some ice.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar va ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan dialoglarni to'ldiring, namunadagidek: put some cream on it, put it in cold water, put a plaster on it, go to the gym tonight, get some cough medicine, get you an aspirin, see your dentist, get some ice.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUAMMO → MASLAHAT / TAKLIF.

  MUAMMO - present perfect (I've
  got / I've cut / I've burnt) yoki
  present (is sunburnt, hurt).

  JAVOB QOLIPLARI:
    Shall I ...? = ... qilaymi?
      (taklif)
    You should ... = ... kerak
    Why don't you ...? = nega ...
      qilmaysiz? (maslahat)
    I'll ... for you = sizga ...
      qilib beraman (taklif)


MOSLIK:

  sunburnt → cream
  headache → aspirin
  cut hand → plaster
  cough → cough medicine
  toothache → dentist
  burnt finger → cold water
  stomach muscles hurt → shouldn't
    go to the gym
  hurt ankle → ice


⚠ 'SUNBURNT':

  = quyoshda kuygan.


⚠ 'A PLASTER':

  Brit. = leykoplastir (AQSh
  'Band-Aid').


⚠ 'MUSCLES':

  = mushaklar. /ˈmʌslz/ - 'c'
  O'QILMAYDI.

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: Bugun kechqurun sport zaliga bormasligingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: John went to the doctor's last week. Look at the list of things John has to do, then write sentences, as in the example. no smoking, no coffee, lose some weight, no junk food, buy a bicycle, join a gym, not go to bed late, work fewer hours. Example: He shouldn't smoke.
exercises.instructionUz: Jon o'tgan hafta shifokorga bordi. Jon qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlar ro'yxatiga qarang, so'ng gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. no smoking, no coffee, lose some weight, no junk food, buy a bicycle, join a gym, not go to bed late, work fewer hours. Namuna: U chekmasligi kerak.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShIFOKOR MASLAHATLARI - SHOULD /
  SHOULDN'T.

  'no ...' / 'not ...' → SHOULDN'T
  qolganlari → SHOULD

  ⚠ 'no smoking' → 'shouldn't
  SMOKE' (fe'l shakli!).
  ⚠ 'no coffee' → 'shouldn't DRINK
  coffee' (fe'l qo'shiladi).
  ⚠ 'no junk food' → 'shouldn't EAT
  junk food'.


⚠ 'TO JOIN A GYM':

  = sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'FEWER HOURS':

  = kamroq soat ('fewer' -
  sanaladigan).


⚠ 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':

  = ozmoq.
modelAnswers: He shouldn't go to bed late.
modelAnswersUz: U sport zaliga a'zo bo'lishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Tick Yes or No, then make sentences about yourself using the present perfect simple, as in the example. Medical Survey - Have you ever ... had the flu? had toothache? had measles? had a tropical disease? broken a bone? had a serious burn? twisted your ankle? Example: I've had the flu. / I've never had the flu.
exercises.instructionUz: Ha yoki Yo'q deb belgilang, so'ng present perfect simple bilan o'zingiz haqingizda gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Tibbiy so'rovnoma - Hech qachon ... grippga chalinganmisiz? tishingiz og'riganmi? qizamiq bo'lganmisiz? tropik kasallik bo'lganmisiz? suyagingiz singanmi? qattiq kuyganmisiz? to'pig'ingizni chiqarganmisiz? Namuna: Men gripp bo'lganman. / Men hech qachon gripp bo'lmaganman.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT - HAYOT TAJRIBASI
  (coursebook 49-bet qoidasi).

  SAVOL: Have you EVER + V3?
    = hech qachon ... misiz?
  HA: I've + V3.
  YO'Q: I've NEVER + V3.

  ⚠ 'ever' faqat SAVOLDA, 'never'
  javobda (inkor bilan EMAS).


V3 ShAKLLARI:

  have → HAD
  break → BROKEN
  twist → TWISTED


⚠ 'THE FLU':

  = gripp ('the' bilan).


⚠ 'MEASLES':

  = qizamiq. '-s' bilan tugasa
  ham BIRLIK.


⚠ 'A TROPICAL DISEASE':

  = tropik kasallik (bezgak
  kabi).


⚠ 'TO TWIST YOUR ANKLE':

  = to'piqni chiqarib olmoq
  (= sprain).


⚠ 'A MEDICAL SURVEY':

  = tibbiy so'rovnoma.
exercises.exampleEn: I've had the flu. / I've never had the flu.
exercises.exampleUz: Men gripp bo'lganman. / Men hech qachon gripp bo'lmaganman.
modelAnswers: I've never had a tropical disease.
I've never had a serious burn.
modelAnswersUz: Men hech qachon tropik kasallik bo'lmaganman.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues and fill in yet, already or just.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va yet, already yoki just qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
YET / ALREADY / JUST (coursebook
  50-bet).

  YET = hali (SO'ROQ va INKORDA,
    gap OXIRIDA):
    'Have you seen a doctor YET?'
    'I haven't finished YET.'
  ALREADY = allaqachon (TASDIQDA,
    have va V3 ORASIDA):
    'He's ALREADY missed two days.'
    'I've ALREADY had measles.'
  JUST = endigina, hozirgina
    (TASDIQDA, have va V3 orasida):
    'I've JUST got back.'
    'I've JUST found out.'


⚠ ALREADY vs JUST:

  just = hozirgina (yaqin vaqt)
  already = allaqachon (kutilgandan
  oldin)
  6-dialog: 'I've ALREADY taken
  one' - aspirin taklif qilindi,
  lekin allaqachon ichgan.


⚠ 'GOT BACK':

  = qaytib keldi.


⚠ 'A TEMPERATURE':

  = harorat (isitma).


⚠ 'IT HASN'T WORKED':

  = ta'sir qilmadi ('work' = ishlamoq,
  ta'sir qilmoq).

patterns.formula: I've got + KASALLIK. - Shall I + FE'L for you?
patterns.exampleEn: I've got a terrible headache. - Shall I get you an aspirin?
patterns.exampleUz: Boshim qattiq og'riyapti. - Aspirin olib kelaymi?

patterns.formula: Have you ever + V3? - I've + V3. / I've never + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever broken a bone? - I've never broken a bone.
patterns.exampleUz: Suyagingiz singanmi? - Suyagim hech qachon sinmagan.

patterns.formula: Have you + V3 ... yet? - I've just/already + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you seen a doctor yet? - I've just got back from the doctor's.
patterns.exampleUz: Shifokorga ko'rindingmi hali? - Hozirgina shifokordan qaytdim.
